notes:
Top-line: mid-market product org (Zenbridge Conversant) building in-app support assistant + semantic search. Currently on another LLM API (OpenAI) but want better cost predictability and SLA. Typical convo style: short, pragmatic.

POC status: running Hosted API proof-of-concept. Goal: confirm prompt parity (exact feature parity for important flows), match latency SLA (<120ms p50 on short queries), and show 20-30% unit-cost savings at scale. Team expects to move to Dedicated once parity and security gating passes.

Observed issues:
- 'pricing_recommendation' prompt returns different product IDs (parity/regression). Likely tokenization/context window differences.
- Cost calc: Redwood Hosted looks 10-15% cheaper for embeddings but generation cost needs Dedicated commit to reach target unit economics.
- SE action items: try prompt-preserving wrappers, adjust sampling/Tokens, test quantized model variants for Dedicated.

Security & Compliance: Zenbridge requires SSO/SAML, SOC2 evidence, KMS integration for key rotation. They asked about audit log retention and optional EU residency for customer data. Legal flagged DPA clauses around model training/usage (want no model training on customer data).

Sales notes / positioning: focus on predictable spend via Dedicated, migration path (compat layer + migration checklist), and Redwood Optimize recommendations for batching to reduce unit cost. Price sensitivity: willing to sign 12-24 month commit if regressions resolved and SLOs guaranteed.

Quotes/EXCERPTS: "If we can't get parity on these recommendation prompts, support ops will choke — we need deterministic behaviour." — Head of Product.

Next immediate steps (short):
1) SE to deliver regression triage write-up by 2025-03-05 with sample prompt diffs and mitigation plan.
2) AE to provide Dedicated sizing and v2 pricing deck.
3) Zenbridge legal to finish DPA review (target 2025-03-12).
implementation_notes: Compatibility path: implement thin compatibility layer that normalizes tokenization and prefix-system messages. SE suggests 'prompt-preserve' wrapper + small templating changes. Test matrix includes: 50 canonical prompts, 200 search queries, and 10 reranking flows. Logging: capture token counts, model variant, and full request/response for triage (redaction required).
deal_health: warm — product team engaged, clear migration incentives (cost + SLA). Biggest risk: regressions impacting customer-facing flows. Legal/security timeline aligned with forecast month.
selling_points_highlighted: Hosted POC speed, clear Dedicated migration path, cost modeling for committed capacity, Redwood Optimize batching suggestions
notes_short_summary: Mid-market SaaS evaluating Hosted -> Dedicated. Running Hosted POC; migration from current LLM provider. Key blockers: prompt parity/regressions + security (VPC/SSO). Next: regression report + Dedicated pricing review.
